solar_flare.name: Solar Flare
solar_flare.text: {planet}'s star erupts. A wall of charged plasma is minutes from the inner system, and the habitat shields are not rated for it.

choices.label: Divert power to the shields
choices.result: The shields hold and the crews cheer. Nothing is lost.

choices.label: Ride it out and study the flare
choices.hint: Risky, but the instruments are rolling.
choices.result: The flare passes. The data it left behind is priceless.
choices.fail_result: A surge cooks a facility on {planet} before the shutdown completes.

choices.label: Evacuate the outer habitats
choices.result: Everyone who matters is safe, but families are scattered for months.

refugee_convoy.name: Refugee Convoy
refugee_convoy.text: A convoy of battered transports drops out of hyperspace near {planet}, broadcasting a plea in six languages. They have nowhere else to go.

choices.label: Welcome them
choices.result: The newcomers settle in. Their children are already in the schools.

choices.label: Screen them for skilled workers
choices.result: Among the refugees are two xenobiologists and a former fleet engineer. The rest move on.

choices.label: Turn them away
choices.result: The transports limp away. Word of it reaches the Free Traders, who are not impressed.

plague.name: Outbreak
plague.text: A fast-moving fever is spreading through {planet}. The hospitals are filling and the governor wants orders.

choices.label: Quarantine the colony
choices.result: The quarantine holds. The fever burns out in a fortnight.

choices.label: Fund a crash cure
choices.hint: 60 credits. Risky, but pays off in research.
choices.result: The lab pulls it off. The cure is already being licensed.
choices.fail_result: The cure comes too late for some. Population falls.

choices.label: Do nothing
choices.result: The fever takes its toll before it fades.

market_boom.name: Market Boom
market_boom.text: Commodity prices across the sector are climbing and everyone wants what your worlds sell.

choices.label: Cash in now
choices.result: The warehouses empty and the treasury fills.

choices.label: Invest in the boom
choices.result: New exchange floors open. Trade surges for a while.

choices.label: Sell strategic reserves
choices.result: The stockpile is cleared at a handsome price.

derelict_signal.name: Derelict Signal
derelict_signal.text: A long-dead beacon near {planet} has started repeating a coded message. Someone, or something, wants it answered.

choices.label: Send an expedition
choices.result: The expedition finds an intact scout craft and a cache of parts.
choices.fail_result: It was a trap. The expedition limps home with scorched hulls.

choices.label: Record and decode it
choices.result: Your analysts map the signal. It is a very old star chart.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: The beacon keeps calling to an empty sky.

first_contact.name: First-Contact Misunderstanding
first_contact.text: A Free Trader envoy has been escorted off {planet} after your protocol officers served the wrong dish at the welcome banquet. The Traders are furious.

choices.label: Apologise with a gift
choices.result: The gift and an embarrassed speech smooth things over.

choices.label: Send a formal apology
choices.result: The envoy accepts the letter with a long sigh.

choices.label: Stand firm
choices.hint: Opinion -12, but your people respect it.
choices.result: The Traders storm off. The banquet's caterers send a bill anyway.

mining_strike.name: Mining Strike
mining_strike.text: The mining crews near {planet} have downed tools over safety and pay. Production is grinding to a halt.

choices.label: Meet their demands
choices.result: The crews return to work with a spring in their step.

choices.label: Negotiate
choices.result: A compromise is found by midnight. Production resumes.
choices.fail_result: Talks collapse. Output is down for a few turns.

choices.label: Break the strike
choices.result: The security teams clear the shafts. Work resumes, grudgingly.

scientific_breakthrough.name: Scientific Breakthrough
scientific_breakthrough.text: A lab on {planet} reports a result that overturns a decade of theory. How the empire uses it is up to you.

choices.label: Publish openly
choices.result: Citations pour in and your labs build on the result within days.

choices.label: Patent it
choices.result: The licensing deals start rolling in.

choices.label: Classify and exploit it
choices.result: The work goes behind closed doors, and the results come faster.

raider_gathering.name: Raider Gathering
raider_gathering.text: Scouts report a raider pack massing in the dark beyond {planet}. They will hit soon, one way or another.

choices.label: Pay them off
choices.result: The raider chief pockets the tribute and sails for easier prey.

choices.label: Fortify the approaches
choices.hint: 40 alloys. Fleets repair +15% per turn for 6 turns.
choices.result: Repair tenders and picket ships move into position.

choices.label: Ignore them
choices.hint: A raider fleet will appear near the system.
choices.result: The raiders arrive within a few turns.

asteroid_windfall.name: Asteroid Windfall
asteroid_windfall.text: A metal-rich asteroid on a slow orbit is about to pass {planet}. Prospectors are already circling.

choices.label: Mine it
choices.result: Tugs haul the rock into dock. The smelters run all week.

choices.label: Sell the claim
choices.result: A syndicate pays well for the rights.

choices.label: Study it
choices.result: The core samples contain isotopes nobody has catalogued.

defector.name: Defecting Scientist
defector.text: A senior researcher from a rival power has slipped into {planet}'s embassy district, asking for asylum and bringing a trunk of notes.

choices.label: Grant asylum
choices.hint: 30 credits. +50 research, relations with rivals suffer.
choices.result: Her notes shave months off your projects. Her old employers are not amused.

choices.label: Return her quietly
choices.result: A rival's ambassador thanks you in a low voice. A favour is owed.

choices.label: Debrief and release
choices.result: You learn what you can and send her on her way.

reactor_accident.name: Reactor Fault
reactor_accident.text: A coolant leak at the yards above {planet} has the reactor chief screaming for a decision.

choices.label: Emergency repairs
choices.result: The crews seal the leak just in time.

choices.label: Vent and write it off
choices.hint: Lose a building, keep the crew.
choices.result: The reactor bay is a hollow shell, but nobody is hurt.

choices.label: Risk it
choices.result: The reactor stabilises on its own. Luck is a resource.
choices.fail_result: The containment fails. The dead are mourned for a long time.

void_leviathan.name: Void Leviathan
void_leviathan.text: A vast creature, kilometres long, drifts through the space near {planet} trailing glittering ice. Your fleet captains have never seen anything like it.

choices.label: Observe from a distance
choices.result: Hours of sensor data. Every biologist in the empire is arguing about it.

choices.label: Hunt it
choices.hint: 50%: +60 alloys of strange ore, otherwise battered ships.
choices.result: The creature dies slowly. Its shed plates are worth a fortune.
choices.fail_result: It tears into the patrol before it submerges into the dark.

choices.label: Steer clear
choices.result: The creature drifts on. A good story for the mess hall.

veteran_volunteers.name: Veteran Volunteers
veteran_volunteers.text: A band of retired officers from the last war has turned up at the recruitment office on {planet}, offering their experience.

choices.label: Commission them
choices.hint: 40 credits. A new hero joins you.
choices.result: The best of them takes a commission and a starship.

choices.label: Hire as instructors
choices.result: Doctrine papers pour out of the academy for a month.

choices.label: Thank them and pay them off
choices.result: They retire again with a generous pension.

salvage_convoy.name: Abandoned Convoy
salvage_convoy.text: A crippled convoy hulk is tumbling past {planet}, with no one answering hails.

choices.label: Tow it in
choices.result: A frigate-class escort turns out to be intact. It is yours now.
choices.fail_result: The hulk breaks up under tow, and the debris scours your tugs.

choices.label: Strip it for parts
choices.result: Tonnes of salvage, no risk.

harvest_festival.name: Bumper Harvest
harvest_festival.text: The farms of {planet} have a record yield. The governor suggests a festival.

choices.label: Feed the colonies
choices.result: Full bellies and new babies. The colony swells.

choices.label: Export the surplus
choices.result: Food convoys leave for hungrier worlds.

choices.label: Fund a festival
choices.result: A week of music and weddings. The birth rate shows it.

trade_envoy.name: Trade Envoy
trade_envoy.text: An envoy of the Free Traders requests an audience in {planet}, bearing a standing-contract proposal.

choices.label: Sign the contract
choices.result: Ink and handshakes. Cargo begins to flow.

choices.label: Counter-offer
choices.hint: 50%: a better deal. Otherwise they leave offended.
choices.result: The envoy blinks, then laughs and agrees.
choices.fail_result: The envoy bows stiffly and leaves.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.result: The envoy shrugs and moves on.

war_weariness.name: War Weariness
war_weariness.text: Casualty lists have been long. Demonstrations are growing on {planet}, demanding an end to the fighting.

choices.label: Rally the people
choices.result: Speeches, parades and overtime. Morale climbs.

choices.label: Reach out to the enemy
choices.result: A back-channel opens. Perhaps peace is possible.

choices.label: Press on
choices.result: The riots are put down. The mood is bitter.

lab_accident.name: Laboratory Accident
lab_accident.text: An experiment aboard the research station above {planet} has gone badly wrong, and the station chief is asking for orders.

choices.label: Contain it
choices.result: Bulkheads seal and the incident is closed.

choices.label: Let the experiment run
choices.hint: 50%: +60 research. Otherwise a building is lost.
choices.result: The experiment succeeds beyond all expectation.
choices.fail_result: The station is gutted by the blast.

ancient_cache.name: Ancient Cache
ancient_cache.text: A landslide on {planet} has exposed a sealed vault of unknown origin. Its door bears a language nobody can read.

choices.label: Crack it open
choices.hint: 50%: +50 research and 30 credits. Otherwise a trap.
choices.result: Inside are working machines and a library of crystal tablets.
choices.fail_result: The vault was a trap. A colonist team never returns.

choices.label: Seal it and survey
choices.result: The surveyors map the vault and leave it for later.

front_sympathisers.name: Front Sympathisers
front_sympathisers.text: Leaflets on {planet}'s concourses overnight: THE COLONIES ARE NOT YOUR MINES. The dock crews have stopped saluting the inspectors, and two shipments of ore went missing last week.

choices.label: Arrest the organisers
choices.hint: 20 credits. 70%: the cell is broken up. Otherwise the Front sends raiders.
choices.result: The organisers are in custody and the missing ore turns up in their lockers.
choices.fail_result: The arrests are a rallying cry. A Front raider pack is already on its way.

choices.label: Hear their grievances
choices.hint: 40 credits: a colonial charter (faster growth for 10 turns).
choices.result: A charter of rights for the outer bodies. The leaflets stop; the colonists start having children again.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.hint: 50%: nothing comes of it. Otherwise sabotage.
choices.result: The leaflets yellow on the walls. Nothing happens.
choices.fail_result: Someone pours abrasive into a development's bearings. It will take four turns to fix.

scavenger_trade.name: A Scavenger's Offer
scavenger_trade.text: A Vrask hauler drifts up to {planet} with its weapons cold and broadcasts in broken Terran: [i]HARD-METAL. YOU GIVE. WE GIVE SHINY-COLD.[/i] Its holds are full of ice. Whose ice, nobody wants to ask.

choices.label: Trade alloys for ice
choices.result: The trade goes through with alien courtesy. The volatiles are good.

choices.label: Ask for what glows
choices.hint: 60 credits. 70%: 3 exotic matter and the samples' data.
choices.result: A sealed canister of violet crystal changes hands. The labs go quiet when they open it.
choices.fail_result: The canister holds coloured glass. Somewhere, a Vrask is laughing.

choices.label: Seize the hauler
choices.hint: 60%: its cargo is yours. Otherwise a scavenger pack answers and your fleets take hits.
choices.result: The hauler's crew flees in a pod. Its holds are yours.
choices.fail_result: The hauler fights back and screams for help. A pack answers.

coronal_mass_ejection.name: Coronal Mass Ejection
coronal_mass_ejection.text: The sun throws off a billion tonnes of plasma. It will cross the inner orbits in hours, and half of your outposts were built without storm cellars.

choices.label: Power everything down
choices.hint: One development goes offline for 2 turns. Safe.
choices.result: The storm passes over dark stations. Two days of lost work, nothing broken.

choices.label: Shield the fleet and stations
choices.result: The shield generators scream for an hour, then the storm is gone. Nobody notices but the engineers.

choices.label: Fly into it with instruments
choices.hint: 55%: +45 research. Otherwise the fleets are burned.
choices.result: The first close readings of our own sun's fury. The physicists are giddy.
choices.fail_result: The storm is stronger than the models. Every ship comes back scorched.

mining_accident.name: Mining Accident
mining_accident.text: A shaft collapses at one of your mining bases. Twelve miners are trapped below, the air scrubbers are failing, and the rescue rig is three days out.

choices.label: Spare nothing for the rescue
choices.hint: 30 credits: the miners' trust (+10% alloys for 8 turns).
choices.result: All twelve walk out. The crews work double shifts for the people who came for them.

choices.label: Seal the shaft, dig elsewhere
choices.hint: A development is offline for 4 turns.
choices.result: The base goes quiet for a memorial and a re-survey. Nobody on the outer bodies forgets it.

choices.label: Send the robots
choices.hint: 20 alloys. 60%: they get everyone out and hit a rich seam.
choices.result: The robots dig the miners out and find a seam of rare metals on the way.
choices.fail_result: The robots bring down the rest of the shaft. Everyone is saved; the base is not.

comet_flyby.name: Comet Flyby
comet_flyby.text: A long-period comet swings through the inner system for the first time in four thousand years: a mountain of dirty ice with a tail longer than the orbit of {planet}.

choices.label: Send a tanker to skim the tail
choices.result: The tanker comes back heavy with fresh ice and helium-3.

choices.label: Study its nucleus
choices.result: Primordial ice, older than the planets. The data will keep the academies busy for years.

choices.label: Mine it before it leaves
choices.hint: 30 alloys. 60%: 18 volatiles and 2 exotic matter. Otherwise the rig is lost.
choices.result: A rig on the comet's back for a month. In its heart: ice, and a few grains of something violet.
choices.fail_result: The comet's jets tear the rig loose. It tumbles into the dark with the comet.

brood_message.name: A Voice in the Static
brood_message.text: Every receiver in the system picks it up at once: clicks and chirps, then a voice stitched together from stolen broadcasts. [i]WE ARE BROOD OF HESK. WE WERE HERE FIRST. YOUR SHINY THINGS ARE OURS. THE COLD MOON IS NOT OURS. DO NOT WAKE IT.[/i]

choices.label: Reply, and record everything
choices.result: The linguists work for a week straight. The Vrask never answer again, but now we can read their markings.

choices.label: Answer with the fleet's guns
choices.hint: Your crews are steeled (+10% fleet repair in the field for 10 turns).
choices.result: A broadcast of gun cameras and a single word: MINE. The crews cheer. The static goes quiet.

choices.label: Jam it
choices.result: Silence. The newsfeeds call it a solar artefact. Some people believe it.

ice_echo.name: Echo Under the Ice
ice_echo.text: The seismometers on the outer moons pick up a pulse, deep under the ice: regular as a clock, counting in primes. The exotic matter readings spike every time it beats.

choices.label: Map the pulse
choices.result: The pulse is an address, and the address is a vault. The survey teams want to go in.

choices.label: Drill for the source
choices.hint: 40 credits. 50%: 4 exotic matter. Otherwise a development is shaken offline.
choices.result: The drill comes up glowing violet.
choices.fail_result: The ice answers the drill with a quake. Something on the surface breaks.

front_defector.name: A Front Defector
front_defector.text: A Front pilot surrenders at {planet} with her hands on her helmet and a shuttle full of stolen ore. She says she joined to free the colonies, not to rob them.

choices.label: Grant her asylum
choices.hint: Keep the ore: 5 rare elements and 25 credits.
choices.result: She signs on as a freighter pilot. The ore goes into the smelters.

choices.label: Send her back as our agent
choices.hint: 60%: +40 research from Front traffic. Otherwise they know, and they come.
choices.result: For months, the Front's plans arrive on your desk a week before they happen.
choices.fail_result: She is found out within a week. The Front wants revenge.

choices.label: Hand her to the courts
choices.hint: The rule of law (+10% credits for 8 turns).
choices.result: A public trial. The inner worlds approve; the outer ones remember.
